{{Top|leg}}
A '''data slate''' was an item of technology that could be used to store official, signed documents &mdash; or imitations of those.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Gode Takrab]] intended to copy a forged treaty supposedly signed by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to a data slate.
